description: This Java class 'StaticContentFileManagerImpl' implements file management operations such as add, remove, and retrieve static content files for a merchant store. It relies on underlying 'FilePut', 'FileGet', and 'FileRemove' components to perform the file operations.

classes.name: StaticContentFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing static content files within a merchant store, providing methods to add, remove, and fetch files through dependencies.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single static content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file based on type and name.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific static content file.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of file names for a given content type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of content files for a given content type.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a merchant store.
